svg.title: UNO - tests and scenario helpers

g.text: Fair moves and seeded complete games
Setup, game, Credits, layout and timer
GameFixture constructs Deck and GameConfig, then calls package-visible GameEngine.scenario.
BotPlayers constructs Player/PlayerConfig test hands and delegates full scenarios to GameFixture.
Six test classes use JUnit 5 annotations/assertions; they do not extend TestCase. Two helpers are fixture classes.
All eight test-source types are shown. Anonymous Random test adapter is omitted; no production bot uses a test fixture.
Dashed arrow: test or fixture dependency. Production classes appear only as external context.
